_source: County centroids computed from the US Census Bureau cartographic county boundaries (plotly/datasets geojson-counties-fips.json, 3,221 county FIPS ids, 2010 vintage): area-weighted centroid of each county's polygons, latitude and longitude rounded to 3 decimals. Key: 5-digit county FIPS (state + county). Used to place county-level weather alerts (lib/signals/adapters/nws.ts). Not a Gazetteer internal point: for a very irregular county it can sit a few miles from it. Revised in round 15 review fixes: (1) 02016 Aleutians West crosses the 180th meridian and was averaged without wrapping (it landed in Saskatchewan); replaced with the Census 2010 Gazetteer geographic center [51.959, 178.339] (btskinner/spatial county_centers.csv, columns clat10/clon10). (2) Added counties created or renamed after 2010: 02063 Chugach, 02066 Copper River (2019 split of 02261) and 02158 Kusilvak (2015 rename of 02270), internal points from the Census TIGERweb 2020 county table (INTPTLAT/INTPTLON); 46102 Oglala Lakota (2015 rename of Shannon 46113, same boundary) uses the Shannon 2010 Gazetteer center [43.342, -102.559]; 09110-09190 Connecticut planning regions (2022) from the Census TIGERweb BAS25 Connecticut table (INTPTLAT/INTPTLON). The old Connecticut counties 09001-09015 stay in the table in case NWS SAME still uses them.
